He married Emma Becker on 10 September 1890 in Hamilton County, Ohio and had a son Charles Hubert Ferber born 22 June 1891 in Cincinnati.

My research objective: Who were William H. Ferber's parents, and where did the family come from?

Please search for the following records and return whatever actual data you find:
1. William H. Ferber in the 1870 US Census (he would be an infant, born December 1869, in his parents' household in Hamilton County or Cincinnati, Ohio)
2. William H. Ferber in the 1880 US Census (he would be about 10 years old, still with parents)
3. Any Ohio death record for William H. Ferber, died 11 March 1903, Cincinnati — Ohio death records from this era name the decedent's parents
4. The FamilySearch public tree entry for G7JB-YH6 — check if parents are already linked in the tree at familysearch.org/tree/person/details/G7JB-YH6

Use WebSearch and/or WebFetch to find this data. Search sites like FamilySearch, Ancestry, Geni, WikiTree, MyHeritage, or any genealogy database that indexes census or vital records.

Return ONLY actual record data you find — names, dates, places as they appear in the records. Do not fabricate or infer. If you cannot find data, say so explicitly.
